findings.title: Single-use closure factory could be inlined
findings.detail: retroLockHeld(env, slug) is called from exactly one place (cmd_retro.go:64) to build the lockBlocked closure. Extracting it into a named top-level function adds one level of indirection for a single caller; an anonymous closure at the construction site would read the same and drop one hop. Not a real problem — the extraction keeps the divergence rationale in its own doc comment, consistent with the file's prose-heavy commenting style — so this is polish only.
